comment_1_note: Get these from Discord Developer Portal (https://discord.com/developers)
discord_token_note: ⚠️  KEEP THIS SECRET! Never share this token with anyone!
client_id_note: Found in Discord Developer Portal > Your App > General Information
guild_id_note: Your Discord server ID (Right-click server > Copy Server ID)
comment_2_note: Right-click channels/categories and select 'Copy ID' (enable Developer Mode first)
closed_ticket_category_id_note: Category where CLOSED tickets will be moved to (right-click category > Copy ID)
log_channel_id_note: Channel where TicketFlow will send logs and reports (right-click channel > Copy ID)
comment_2_note2: Note: New ticket categories are created automatically based on ticket types
comment_3_note: Right-click roles in Server Settings and select 'Copy Role ID'
admin_role_id_note: Full control over tickets (claim, close, delete, manage users)
support_team_role_id_note: Support team role (will be mentioned in new tickets)
auto_close_enabled_note: Set to false to disable auto-close feature
auto_close_days_note: Days of inactivity before auto-closing ticket (users warned 24h before)
max_tickets_per_user_note: Maximum open tickets per user (prevents spam)
comment_6_note: Customize the appearance of the ticket creation panel

ticket_embed.title: 🎫 TicketFlow Support
ticket_embed.title_note: Main title of the ticket panel
ticket_embed.description: Thank you for contacting our support team. Please describe your issue in detail and we'll get back to you as soon as possible.
ticket_embed.description_note: Description text shown in the panel
ticket_embed.color_note: Hex color code (examples: #0099ff blue, #00aa00 green, #ff0000 red)

comment_7_note: These options appear in the dropdown menu when users create a ticket

ticket_options.label: Report a Bug
ticket_options.description: Report a bug or issue with the bot.

ticket_options.label: Feature Request
ticket_options.description: Suggest a new feature or improvement.

comment_7_note2: Note: The emoji will be used in the category name (e.g., '🐛-Bug Report')
comment_7_note3: requiresReason: If true, users will be asked to provide more details when creating a ticket
ticket_options_note: You can add, remove, or modify these options as needed
